home.title: Nicolas Planche
home.subtitle: Full-Stack & Mobile Developer
home.description1: Tech enthusiast, I design mobile and web applications as well as solid back-ends.
home.description2: I use modern technologies such as Flutter, Laravel, Vue/Nuxt, Next/React, Tailwind CSS and DevOps practices to deliver complete, user-oriented and high-quality software solutions.

about.title: About me
about.subtitle: Create, learn, iterate
about.description1: Passionate full-stack developer, I love bringing to life products that combine aesthetics, performance and meaning.
about.description2: My approach is based on technical rigor, curiosity and a constant desire to learn and progress.
about.description3: From front to back, I pay particular attention to every detail: designing a fluid interface, structuring a clean architecture, optimizing performance or ensuring code maintainability.
about.description4: My goal is simple: create useful, pleasant to use and easy to evolve applications.
about.description5: I enjoy collaborating with motivated teams, confronting ideas and finding solutions best suited to users' real needs.
about.description6: Each project is for me a new opportunity to experiment, improve my practices and push my limits to deliver reliable and sustainable products.

projects.title: Projects
projects.subtitle: From concept to production.
projects.description: Each project is an opportunity to transform an idea into a concrete solution.

skills.title: Skills
skills.subtitle: Learn by practice, master by rigor.
skills.description: I learned by coding, testing and debugging, until development became much more than a job: a way of thinking. As a full-stack developer, I design performant, maintainable and scalable web and mobile applications, always seeking to push my limits and enrich my stack through projects.

experiences.title: Experience
experiences.subtitle: You need experience to get the job... but it's the job that gives experience!
experiences.description1: Throughout my journey as a full-stack developer, I’ve had the chance to work on a bit of everything — from mobile applications built with Flutter, to robust Laravel APIs, and elegant web interfaces crafted with Nuxt, Next.js, and React. Each project has been a learning ground, balancing creativity and technical rigor — sometimes refining an animation, sometimes hunting down a bug that only appears in production at 2 a.m.
experiences.description2: These experiences have taught me far more than theory: how to write clean code, collaborate efficiently, and always seek to understand before fixing. What I enjoy most? Turning complex ideas into performant, useful, and enjoyable products.

education.title: Education
education.subtitle: Learn, experiment, evolve.
education.description1: From my scientific background in high school to my Bachelor's degree in Mathematics and Computer Science at the University of Lyon 1, I built a strong foundation in logic and software design.
education.description2: My Full-Stack Developer Master's at MyDigitalSchool Lyon marked a key milestone, it allowed me to strengthen my web and mobile development skills through real-world projects combining performance, design, and user experience.

contact.title: Contact
contact.description1: Got a project in mind? An opportunity to share?
contact.description2: I’d be happy to discuss it with you. Leave me a message below.
contact.description3: Looking forward to hearing from you!
